tagline: Sanitized worked example: observed failures become narrow binary regression tests.
evaluation_contract: Test whether contact extraction, application logging, and pipeline analysis respect grounding and user-approval boundaries. Blocking failures prevent release even when the aggregate pass rate is high.
limitations: This public example contains fictionalized reproductions derived from observed failure modes. It is not the private production dataset, does not estimate real-world prevalence, and does not validate a model judge.
evaluator_summary: All six example cases use deterministic subset assertions. This is sufficient for structured fields, counts, grounding markers, and approval state. Natural-language usefulness remains outside this small public example.
judge_calibration: No model judge is used. Adding one would require human-labeled train, development, and untouched test sets plus separate true-positive and true-negative reporting.
